brief: A phone charging station: a closed box with a cover that lets a cable pass through.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single full cell piece:0,0,0 with cable cover on top (cover:0,0,0;full;top type=cable) and 6 solid end caps cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330 enclosing all side faces; check_build clear.

requirements.requirement: Cover that lets a cable pass through
requirements.evidence: Top cover set to type 'cable' (cable entry slot) plus side port gland port:0#0,0#0 for cable ingress; phone prop on deck shows charging station use.

finish.summary: Built 1-cell closed box with cable-type top cover and port gland for cable pass-through, side caps closed, staged with phone.

events.text: Your charging box is on deck — I'll build a closed box with a ported cover for the cable.

parts.name: Cable comb
parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.

parts.name: Cable comb, two stories tall
parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.

parts.name: Cable comb, three stories tall
parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 3/4 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 1/2 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 1 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

events.text: I've got your base ready — now assembling the enclosed box with a dedicated cable port.

result.note: A cover goes on an open top or side face of a base. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: The shell is sealed — now I'll finish the details so it's ready for your phone and charger.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
